articles.summary: BBVA reported a net attributable profit of €9.07 billion for the period from January through September 2026, up 13.6 percent year-over-year
articles.title: Earnings: BBVA Exceeds €9 Billion in Profit in the First Nine Months of 2026 and Increases Lending by 20 Percent Year-on-Year

articles.summary: BBVA has completed the first tranche of the extraordinary €2 billion share buyback programme it announced at the end of July. Between 5 August and 1 October 2026, the bank repurchased shares worth €1 billion.
articles.title: BBVA completes the first €1 billion of its new share buyback programme

articles.summary: BBVA is entering a new phase from a position of leadership and credibility, following years of transforming its business model and building relationships with its customers.
articles.title: BBVA embarks on a new growth phase in Spain, with customers at its heart and AI at the forefront

articles.summary: On October 15, BBVA will pay its shareholders 37 cents per share in cash as a gross interim dividend against 2026 earnings. This amount is nearly 16 percent higher than in 2025 and represents the highest interim dividend in BBVA’s history. In total, the bank will distribute approximately €2.0 billion to its shareholders¹.
articles.title: BBVA shareholders to receive 37 cents per share on October 15, its highest interim dividend ever

articles.summary: Garanti BBVA has been named ‘Best Consumer Digital Bank in Turkey at Global Finance’s World’s Best Digital Bank Awards.
articles.title: Garanti BBVA Named Turkey’s Best Consumer Digital Bank by Global Finance

articles.summary: DBRS Ratings has upgraded BBVA's credit rating from A (high) to AA (low), with a stable outlook.
articles.title: DBRS Ratings upgrades BBVA's credit rating to AA (low)

articles.summary: The Group’s wholesale banking division closed September with strong performance, driven by a 21% year-on-year increase in revenues (at constant euros, excluding the accounting impact of the hyperinflation adjustment). All business units contributed to this performance, posting double-digit growth: Global Markets (GM), +18%; Global Transaction Banking (GTB), +21%; and Investment Banking & Finance (IB&F), +34%. Loan book increased by 32% compared with December 2025, with significant contributions from Project Finance and Corporate Lending in Asia and the United States, as well as from the transaction banking business. Meanwhile, attributable profit reached €1.044 billion in the third quarter and stood at €3.082 billion at the end of September 2026, representing a year-on-year increase of 19% at constant euros.
articles.title: BBVA CIB posts revenues of €6.351 billion through September 2026

articles.summary: This Wednesday, October 14, BBVA will resume the execution of its extraordinary share buyback programme of up to €2 billion euros, announced on July 30.
articles.title: BBVA launches a second tranche of €1 billion of its share buyback programme

articles.summary: BBVA is strengthening its commitment to high-net-worth clients with the launch of Global Wealth, a new umbrella brand bringing together the Premium, Private Banking and Ultra High Net Worth (UHN) segments.
articles.title: BBVA launches Global Wealth, its new global offering for high-net-worth clients
